properties.description:
Support Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom within the text editor in text and expression modes, preserving the viewed location and editing context.

Implemented in commit `6331198` and live in the restarted service. Zoom is local to each editor; selection, source position, coloring, gutter alignment and undo history remain intact. Ordinary wheel scrolling is unchanged.

Validation: exact before/after recordings and focused editor regressions pass. The full checkpoint passed build, type, model, unit and integration checks; browser results were 379 passed and one pre-existing CRLF/LF failure in private-space-recovery-ui.spec.ts. Report: `.harness/checkpoints/run-zMLbCh/report.json`. Evidence is attached.
properties.title: Zoom the text editor with Ctrl + mouse wheel
